rationale: Per Maudsley 15th edition (Schizophrenia chapter, p.216–217). Smoking induces CYP1A2, accelerating clozapine clearance. Female smokers therefore need a higher target maintenance dose (300 mg/day) than female non-smokers (225 mg/day). If the patient stops smoking during or after titration, clozapine levels can rise sharply — measure plasma level and reduce dose if necessary. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

steps.notes: First test dose 6.25 mg evening. Lying and standing BP at 1, 2 and 4 hours post-dose.
Counsel about hypersalivation and constipation. Start prophylactic laxative.
Hold a day if tolerability concerns.
Maintenance target reached. If patient stops smoking, plasma levels can rise sharply — recheck level and consider dose reduction.

postTitrationGuidance: Maintain at 300 mg/day. Smoking cessation post-titration can substantially raise clozapine levels — monitor plasma levels closely and reduce dose proportionally if needed. Faster titration may be appropriate in younger patients without prominent dose-related side effects.
missedDoseRule: Doses missed for more than 48 hours mandate retitration. Use the Interruption Restart Wizard.
